metadata.label: negative
metadata.reference: A photorealistic forest clearing with tall pine trees, solid ground, and scattered fallen leaves, where the tree trunks cast uniform straight shadows but the sunlight patches on the ground misalign with the canopy, and several leaves on the floor cast shadows in opposite directions from the main light, highly detailed, no text.
metadata.rationale: Sunlight patches on the forest floor contradict the overhead canopy shape, and nearby leaves cast shadows in conflicting directions.
